definitions.gloss: to develop (a disease); to show symptoms; to onset
definitions.explanation: For a disease or medical condition to begin manifesting symptoms. The subject is typically a person, and the focus is on the appearance of symptoms rather than the cause.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{発症|はっしょう}する。
⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{数日後|すうじつご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発症|はっしょう}した。
examples.english: Symptoms appeared several days after infection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{発症|はっしょう}する⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people develop hay fever when spring comes.

notes:
Used specifically in medical contexts to describe the onset of symptoms of a disease or condition. The noun form ⟦{発症|はっしょう}→発症：09016_hasshou⟧ is also commonly used on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発症|はっしょう}する: to develop a disease
- ⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{発症|はっしょう}する: symptoms appear
- ⟦{発症|はっしょう}→発症：09016_hasshou⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: time of onset
- ⟦{発症|はっしょう}→発症：09016_hasshou⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: incidence rate
- ⟦{発症|はっしょう}→発症：09016_hasshou⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧: risk of developing (a disease)
- ⟦{発症|はっしょう}→発症：09016_hasshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent onset

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発病|はつびょう}する→発病する：27043_hatsubyousuru⟧: to fall ill — similar meaning but slightly older/more literary; ⟦{発症|はっしょう}→発症：09016_hasshou⟧ focuses on symptom appearance
- ⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to catch (a disease) — everyday word for getting sick; less clinical
- {罹患|りかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be affected by (a disease) — more formal/medical, focuses on contracting rather than symptom onset

REGISTER:
Formal/medical. Standard in news reports, medical documents, and health discussions. In casual conversation, people more often say ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧.
